changeinfo.changes:
• The game has been updated to be compatible with the additional content available on the PlayStation®Store.
  • New Game and "Resume Gameplay" have been integrated into the option "Begin" on the Title Screen. Also, the option to delete individual save data has been added.
  • In "Fishy Tales of the Nekomata," the Avatar gauge will stop being consumed when battle results are displayed.
  • Various parameters have been adjusted in Genroku Legends, such as relaxing the conditions required for equipping abilities.
  • Various system-related issues were addressed to improve navigation through the game.
  • The game's frame rate has been stabilized during certain circumstances.
